lines.description: The whole chapter, in order, as spoken lines. Nothing omitted, nothing added.

speaker.description: "narrator" for narration, otherwise the character id from the bible that speaks the line.

text.description: The words to be spoken, verbatim from the chapter apart from the speech normalizations in the instructions. No quotation marks around dialogue.

direction.description: A short performance note for this line when the text calls for one ("shouting, panicked"), otherwise empty string.

notes.description: Anything the renderer or a human reviewer should know: an attribution you were unsure of, a passage that is a letter or a list, a term you normalized.
